items:
Imagine a vacation home so thoughtfully designed that every detail has been incorporated to provide guests memories and experiences they will enjoy for years to come. Voted VRBO 2024 Vacation Home Of The Year - as seen in Travel & Leisure Magazine, USA TODAY, and FORBES Magazine. Welcome to Paradise Found 30A!

Paradise Found 30A is a multi family, luxury vacation home designed for all ages. The home boasts 7 ½ spacious bedrooms, each with en suite bathrooms, 3 living areas, a chef's kitchen and unrivaled outdoor space. The open concept living room creates a spectacular experience by creating an indoor/outdoor concept by sliding the glass doors flush into the wall, opening to the outdoor space. 2 separate dining areas accommodate the need for adult seating and child/teen seating. The upstairs includes a suite with it's own living room, perfect for parents with children or a mother-in-law suite. The second floor boasts a luxury kids living room, complete with ample seating, ping pong, TV and dedicated snack bar with refrigerator.

LOCATION: The home is located between the most attractive areas on the coveted East end of 30A. The HUB, Rosemary, Alys, Seacrest and Kaia are all within 1-2 miles of the home and are easy to access by walking or biking. These areas boast outstanding restaurants, activities and gathering areas to enjoy the best of the 30A lifestyle.

BEACH ACCESS: The home is 4 houses back from a beautiful private, deeded beach access. There is always plenty of room and space at this beach access. The beach access itself is called Seabreeze and can be seen in pictures with the listing. The distance is approximately 100 yards or under a 5 minute walk. ***Recently there have been articles and some upset guests noting some of the beach has been privatized, which has limited guests space. Our beach access is quite wonderful and is completely unaffected. You can expect plenty of space and no overcrowding.

The outdoor space is one of the premiere pool and entertaining areas on 30A. Walk from your living room directly into the zero entry, salt water, infinity edge, heated pool. A large hot tub and sun shelf accompany the pool to create a serene and relaxing environment. The zero entry feature, complete with bubblers and shooting jets is perfect for entertaining for babies and young children. Guests will enjoy a dedicated "adults only" section of the pool that hosts 5 sunken barstools, and a sunken bench seat that sits next to the cabana and TV area. The barstool area has pavers that overhang to allow for resting drinks or even eating dinner! Families will enjoy the beautiful outdoor kitchen with built in grill, beautiful outdoor dining area. The covered cabana area creates an atmosphere worthy of the name "Paradise Found". Relax on the comfy swing bed and watch your family enjoy the pool or sit in one of 4 swivel chairs that can interact with guests in the pool or in prime position to watch your favorite sports team. Walk down to the "active lawn" to experience the water plunging over the pool while you play corn hole, bocce ball mind or simply relax and read a book. The exotic palms, banana leaf trees and other tropical landscape complete the experience of true relaxation in enjoying your hard earned vacation.

Paradise Found 30A is outfitted with every amenity you can imagine. From the moment you drive up, the garage is outfitted with a charger dedicated to electric vehicles (EV). Hop in the 6 seater golf cart and take a leisurely drive down to Seaside or the HUB to watch a game. 6 adult YOLO bikes and 4 kid YOLO bikes are included to visiting your favorite area convenient. You'll also find a variety of water toys including 2 kayaks, a smaller kayak, stand up paddle board and Hobie Boards. Beach chairs, beach towels, umbrellas, cooler, and a beach wagon are also provided to maximize the fun and minimize the effort. The kitchen is fully stocked for the passionate chefs. This includes gorgeous tableware, wine glasses, extra large cookware, crockpot, 12 piece coffee and espresso station, etc. In addition, creature comforts are incorporated throughout the home such as blankets and fans in each bedroom and a Sonos sound system in the kitchen/living room.

CONVENIENCE: The home is conveniently 1 mile from a main North/South road (Watersound Parkway) that provides immediate access Highway 98, which allows the ability to travel East towards Panama City Beach or West, towards Destin. We are absolutely thrilled to announce there has also been a huge development built at the intersection of Watersound Parkway and Highway 98 (approximately 2 or 3 miles from the house). The development includes a new Publix which has a pharmacy and liquor store, a charming open air gathering spot used for Farmers Market and other family entertainment and plenty of new casual and high end restaurants.

Babies/Small Children- The mid level suite over the garage let's parents "get away" from the active areas of the home. It allows parents to have a sleeping and living room connected to their bedroom that is all private to the rest of the home. Young children will also enjoy bunk rooms outfitted with USB ports for any technology. The zero entry pool includes a "splash pad" with guzzlers and fountain jets that shoot water up; perfect for infants or small children. 2 Pack N Plays also provided.

Teens- Bedrooms with 2 double beds each have been dedicated to teens who need space sleeping. The upstairs living room allows teen's to have a dedicated space to watch TV, eat snacks, play games or relax on their private upstairs patio, complete with swing bed. Of course the teens will also enjoy all of the outdoor space. The large pool, hot tub, covered cabana and active lawn will keep your teens busy for days. The quick access to the beach gives peace of mind they are not too far away.

Adults- Every bedroom includes a king bed, luxury mattress and sheets and it's own ensuite bathroom. Luxury details surround the home inside and out, creating a sense of a true luxury vacation. The removable walls that create an indoor/outdoor living area create a seamless environment transitioning from the living room to your outdoor oasis. Find a remote spot to take a nap, watch a football game while sitting in the pool getting served burgers. Jump in the golf cart for a night out to dinner. Whatever your desire is,

Senior Guests- The home has been built to accommodate senior guests throughout the property. The side door by the garage provides a ramp (No Steps) to access the home. Multiple bedrooms are located on the main level to allow unobstructed maneuverability to the kitchen and living room. Senior guests can also easily access the outdoor areas and have multiple shaded areas to partake in and enjoy all of the family activities.

We sincerely hope you enjoy your stay and create life long memories at Paradise Found 30A. We are appreciative you have considered spending your vacation in our home. If there are any questions prior to booking, while on your vacation, or even afterwards, we are happy to help and are only a phone call away.

***For any additional questions or clarifications, please feel free to search Paradise Found 30A on the web or on social media.
***October-April stays will have a pool charge of $100 per day. VRBO will automatically include this in the quote it generates.
***Fireplace is non operational due to persistent issues that create safety concerns.
***Please note the pool is a very large body of water and takes many hours to warm up. If it is winter time, it can take as many as 5-7 hours. In extreme cold, the system can shut itself off until the temperatures warm the pool above 50 degrees.
***Any cancellation will be charged 3%. This charge comes directly from the credit card processor and is not marked up. If you re-book, I will pay for the 3%, so it is not
charged twice.

They didn’t miss any detail when designing this home and it was fully equipped with everything we needed for a girls beach trip. We will absolutely be back!!!"

Discover the area's water adventures with kayaking and scuba diving nearby, or enjoy the great outdoors with hiking and ecotours.

items: The kitchen is equipped handsomely with the highest end furnishings available. The glass and plate settings are elegant and durable. The cookware and utensils are the highest quality available. The home has been stocked with gadgets to help your cooking to be as easy as well as delicious. Bar stools surround the island to allow guests to socialize while others cook or to allow kids a dedicated area to eat away from the adults.
The "active lawn" is located directly below the infinity pool and accessed by the stairs. This area includes artificial turf and an area to play bocce ball, corn hole or whatever sounds fun.
